standing: OPEN — five work items, one class. The inspector reds; each component's owner disposes (no-enforcer, gated ownership).
the_trouble: Five BaseDevice subclasses inherit emit() and never call it outside proofs: bus, ground_loop, tester, trouble, web_server. MAP.md:434 (2026-07-14): 'Every major state transition and every interface boundary is logged (base reflex, inherited)... no device can opt out.' A device CAN currently opt out by simply not calling — the base gives the capability, nothing makes the crossing use it. The bus is the sharpest instance: it is the boundary the logging standard names FIRST, and it is silent at every crossing.
why_it_matters: Law 7 — a silent device fails invisibly (the system_rackmount went-red-silently gap, systemic). Also the exact history: 'i have been resigned to the fact that we wouldn't have such logging until some lever presented itself' (Akien, 2026-07-27) — this ticket is the lever's first pull.
